Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, our procurement and exec teams want a concise MAP and a confirmed EB (executive briefing) slot to align evaluations and finalize commercial terms. To help us move quickly, I attached an initial MAP_v1.xlsx and a rough EB deck (EB-deck-draft.pdf).

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood commit to an EB week in early December? We're prioritizing Dec 6–10 and would prefer Dec 8 or 9 for our execs.
- Can you map who from Redwood will own the EB (executive sponsor + product lead)?
- We'd like a clear evaluation plan: technical deep-dive, pilot sign-off criteria, and procurement timeline.

Our procurement team needs a target signature date by mid-December to stay on our fiscal cadence. Procurement has been cc'd — Tom, can you confirm internal constraints?

Appreciate a quick outline of next steps so we can lock calendar invites and prep attendees.

Best,

Thanks and +1 on locking an EB slot in early December. Proposed approach from Redwood:

- Technical sponsor (deep dive): Karthik Iyer (Director, Applied ML) — will run the technical walkthrough and pilot criteria
- CS & adoption lead: Marissa Cole — 30/60/90 onboarding plan and success metrics

Evaluation plan (high level)
- Week of Nov 22: Technical deep dive (platform integration, data controls, KV caching behavior)
- Week of Nov 29: Short pilot with sample workloads (2-3 days)
- Dec 1: Pilot review + sign-off criteria checklist populated
- Dec 8: Executive Briefing (EB) for final alignment, decision window opens

Action items

- Karthik: please confirm security/compliance readiness and any artifacts we need to provide to Acme procurement.
- Sofia/Tom: confirm which Acme execs will attend (CEO? Head of Infra? Procurement lead).
